meaning.tr: indir- fiili ve -gen ekinden: durmadan indiren.
meaning.en: Turkish indir- (to download) + -gen (one who keeps doing it): the one that keeps downloading.

description.tr: yt-dlp ve gallery-dl'i tek arayüzde toplayan, motorlarını hep en son kararlı sürümde tutan kendi sunucunda çalışan medya indirici.
description.en: Self-hosted media downloader: yt-dlp and gallery-dl behind one interface, always on the latest stable engines.
